about: Every pair the old late-pairing rule merged (same kind class, within 30 s, the same 3-word line of his - or, for word slips, the same word from Amal), re-validated under the rule of 2026-10-05: merge only with evidence of the same error (same rule, or the same wrong / right piece), one partner each.

rows.why: merged: the same line of his and the same piece, written in the two alphabets
rows.read_by_hand: same slip: both rows are the extra 'min' after khaaf before a verb (Amal: 'here you don't need min'); the readers wrote it in Latin under C11, the sweep in Arabic under D2 - one error, filed under two rules

readers_row.medi_said: ‹Ahna il tinen›, ‹bin khaf, bin khaf min, is it ‹nakun ahel›?
readers_row.amal_said: Oh, here ‹hala ma btihtaj min›. ‹Bin khaf nakun›.
readers_row.why: khaaf takes min before a noun, but before a verb no min; she said 'here you don't need min' and he said bin khaf nikun.

sweep_row.medi_said: ‹Ahna il tinen›, ‹bin khaf, bin khaf min, is it ‹nakun ahel›?
sweep_row.amal_said: Oh, here ‹hala ma btihtaj min›. ‹Bin khaf nakun›.
sweep_row.why: kept min before a verb after khaaf (min only before a noun)

rows.why: merged: the same line of his and the same rule (B1)

readers_row.medi_said: Ana, ana ban biscuit. ashann ihna aa taalam natal ana naataallam
readers_row.why: 'I get happy because we learn' - 3ashan meaning 'because' keeps the present b-; he said bare nit3allam (and wavered ana / ihna), she recast ihna bnet3allam and he repeated it.

sweep_row.medi_said: Ana, ana ban biscuit. ashann ihna aa taalam natal ana naataallam

rows.why: merged: the same word from Amal (her fix)

readers_row.medi_said: كراجي. See, This is a new word.
readers_row.why: Amal volunteered كهربجي (electrician) at 09:10 while he was stuck on مهندس الـ...; he never had the word (09:39 'See, this is a new word'; 09:48 'it's not on our list'), his 09:30 كرهبجي / 09:39 كراجي are first tries at it and her 09:42 is a re-teach - a didn't-know, tier 0, not a wrong form of a known word; not on her sheet.

rows.read_by_hand: same moment: 'Asafa' guessed for stars, Amal gave نجمة

readers_row.medi_said: Is it Asafa؟ Is that, is that stars؟ ... شو يعني stars؟
readers_row.amal_said: One star is نجمة. What's multiple؟ ... نجوم.
readers_row.why: Didn't-know: he guessed عاصفة (storm) for stars, Amal said no / storm, he asked for stars and she supplied نجمة and the plural نجوم (sheet: star | Nejme | نجمة).

readers_row.medi_said: معروف is ground؟ معروف؟ No. ... مرفوف؟ What was What was ground؟
readers_row.why: He tried معروف (known) and مرفوف for 'ground (meat)' - different words/non-word - then asked; Amal supplied مفروم (sheet: 'ground beef | La7meh mafrumeh'). Half a didn't-know, so tier could be argued 0.

rows.read_by_hand: same slip: -ni for -ki on 'daya u ni'

readers_row.medi_said: daya u-- daya u ni. Daya u ni.
readers_row.why: 'Did they upset you' (to a woman) takes the object ending -ki, he put -ni (me); Amal prompted 'You.' and he fixed to daya u ki at 45:45, she said ممتاز; chat daaya2uki.

sweep_row.medi_said: daya u-- daya u ni. Daya u ni.

readers_row.medi_said: No, ربيع is spring. And then صيف is summer. شتاء is winter. Uh, let's see.
readers_row.why: He listed the other three seasons and stalled on autumn; Amal supplied خريف and he said 'That's right' - a didn't-know (sheet: autumn / fall | 5areef).

rows.why: split: the two rows quote the same line of his but nothing shows the same error - rules C11 / none, wrong pieces 'mashhur bi atbuk' / 'بـ أطبخ', right pieces 'مشهور بطبخ الكباب' / 'بالطبخ'; the readers' row and the 09-24 sweep's row are two rows again

readers_row.medi_said: would it be a-ana mash-mashhur bi-ut-bi atbuk without the bi, right?
readers_row.amal_said: في. في or be. في، mm, the noun. Noun is طبخ.
readers_row.why: After bi / fi the noun of the action goes, not a verb; Amal said 'the noun is طبخ' and he produced bi طبخ الكباب (38:29).

sweep_row.medi_said: would it be a-ana mash-mashhur bi-ut-bi atbuk without the bi, right?
sweep_row.amal_said: في. ... في or be. ... في، mm, the noun. Noun is طبخ.
sweep_row.why: verb after a preposition - needs the verbal noun
